wd_meal-item.title: Classic Margherita Stone-Baked Pizza
wd_meal-item.description: A crisp, golden pizza base topped with fresh tomato, melted mozzarella, and fragrant basil. Simple ingredients baked at high heat create an authentic Italian-style Margherita right at home.
wd_meal-item.ingredients: Pizza dough - 1 ball (250 g) Tomato passata - 120 g Fresh mozzarella - 125 g Extra-virgin olive oil - 1 tbsp Fresh basil leaves - handful Salt - pinch
wd_meal-item.steps: 1. Spread the tomato passata evenly over the rolled-out dough. 2. Tear the mozzarella into pieces and distribute across the base. 3. Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle lightly with salt. 4. Place the pizza on a baking tray or preheated stone. 5. Insert into the oven. 6. Select Bake, set 220°C, and cook for 12 minutes or until the crust is golden. 7. Remove from the oven and top with fresh basil leaves. 8. Slice and serve immediately.

wd_meal-item.title: Lemon Herb Baked Salmon Fillets
wd_meal-item.description: Fresh salmon is seasoned simply with lemon, herbs, and olive oil. Baking gently keeps the fillets moist and flaky, making this a light, flavorful everyday dish.
wd_meal-item.ingredients: Salmon fillets - 4 pieces (150 g each) Lemon - 1 Olive oil - 1 tbsp Fresh dill - small bunch Garlic - 1 clove, minced Salt and black pepper - to taste
wd_meal-item.steps: 1. Place the salmon fillets on a lined baking tray. 2. Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with garlic, salt, and pepper. 3. Slice the lemon and lay the slices on top of each fillet. 4. Add small sprigs of dill. 5. Insert the tray into the oven. 6. Select Bake, set 200°C, and cook for 14 minutes. 7. Remove carefully and squeeze a little fresh lemon juice over the top. 8. Serve with extra dill if desired.

wd_meal-item.title: Garlic Butter Roasted Chicken Thighs
wd_meal-item.description: These chicken thighs are coated in a simple garlic butter and roasted until crisp and golden. A comforting and flavorful dish with minimal preparation.
wd_meal-item.ingredients: Chicken thighs - 6 pieces Butter - 40 g, melted Garlic - 2 cloves, minced Paprika - 1 tsp Thyme - 1 tsp Salt and pepper - to taste
wd_meal-item.steps: 1. Mix melted butter with garlic, paprika, thyme, salt, and pepper. 2. Place chicken thighs on a baking tray and brush generously with the garlic butter. 3. Add an extra sprinkle of paprika for color if desired. 4. Insert the tray into the oven. 5. Select Roast, set 190°C, and cook for 30 minutes. 6. Halfway through, spoon juices over the chicken. 7. When the skin is crisp and golden, remove from the oven. 8. Let rest 5 minutes before serving.

wd_meal-item.title: Oven-Roasted Vegetable Medley
wd_meal-item.description: A colorful mix of carrots, zucchini, peppers, and onions roasted until lightly caramelized. A versatile side dish that pairs with almost any main.
wd_meal-item.ingredients: Carrots - 2 Zucchini - 2 Red pepper - 1 Yellow pepper - 1 Red onion - 1 Olive oil - 2 tbsp Salt and pepper - to taste
wd_meal-item.steps: 1. Cut all vegetables into even-sized pieces. 2. Place onto a baking tray and drizzle with olive oil. 3. Season with salt and pepper and toss to coat. 4. Spread vegetables into a single layer. 5. Insert tray into the oven. 6. Select Bake, set 200°C, and cook for 18 minutes, stirring once halfway. 7. Remove when edges begin to brown slightly. 8. Serve immediately as a side or warm salad.

wd_meal-item.title: Molten Chocolate Lava Cakes
wd_meal-item.description: Soft individual chocolate cakes with a warm, molten center. Perfectly indulgent yet quick to prepare - an ideal dessert for any occasion.
wd_meal-item.ingredients: Dark chocolate - 120 g Butter - 80 g Eggs - 2 whole + 2 yolks Sugar - 50 g Flour - 30 g Cocoa powder - for dusting
wd_meal-item.steps: 1. Melt chocolate and butter together in a heatproof bowl. 2. Whisk in the sugar, eggs, and yolks until smooth. 3. Fold in the flour gently. 4. Grease four ramekins and dust with cocoa powder. 5. Pour batter evenly into the ramekins. 6. Insert into the oven. 7. Select Bake, set 210°C, and cook for 9 minutes until edges set and centers remain soft. 8. Rest 1 minute, turn out onto plates, and serve warm.
